sources.quote: 7.1.5.3.2 Verification of a special characteristic by an external laboratory needs prior notification to Stellantis and acceptance of the laboratory scope.
Annex A: programs STL-Torino-27 and STL-Torino-31.
Note: Tensile tests are performed in the Plant 1 internal materials laboratory.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL

findings.why: BR-220 is on STL-Torino-27 (customer STL). Its yield strength Rp0.2 is special characteristic SC-01, checked at control plan line 30 by tensile test in the internal Plant 1 laboratory. Moving that test to the external Laboratorio Sigma is external-lab verification of a special characteristic. CSR-STL-2026-02 clause 7.1.5.3.2 requires prior notification to Stellantis and acceptance of the lab scope. No document in force records that notification or acceptance. The control method also changes, which 8.3.3.3 may cover with written approval. Notification and acceptance are needed before the external tests are used.
